title: Sweet Escape | Charming 30A Beach Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Sweet Escape is a luxury WaterColor home with a private cocktail pool, golf cart, bikes, outdoor lounge, and full access to Beach Club and Camp WaterColor.
description_expanded: Sweet Escape Features - Private cocktail pool - can be heated for an additional fee October through April. - Complimentary Use of a 6-seater LSV (golf cart). Some restrictions apply and must sign a waiver to use the cart during your stay - Enjoy 5 Taxi bikes during your stay. Perfect for exploring WaterColor and 30A - Screened-in outdoor lounge with cushioned seating, fireplace, summer kitchen, outdoor dining, and TV - Fenced-in sundeck with lounge seating and Adirondack seating - Outdoor shower - Parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway and 1 vehicle in the garage - Designer interiors throughout the home - 1st floor Main Living Room with fireplace and views of the pool through the double French door entrances - Workspace off main living room with built-in desk and chair - WIFI and cable throughout home - 2nd floor Family Room with TV and Queen Sleeper Sofa - Chef's kitchen with high-end appliances including Keurig and Wolf Oven - HE washer and dryer in laundry room - Dining for 7 around the dining table plus nearby breakfast bar seating for 5 - Access to the WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and all WaterColor community pools for 12 guests age 5 and older included with your reservation - Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Strict No Pet Policy due to allergies - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to our Sweet Escape. This designer home has everything you want for the ultimate WaterColor luxury vacation including a great location in the quieter Crossings district of the neighborhood. Only a 5 min bike ride or golf cart ride to Camp WaterColor! The first floor features a gourmet kitchen, dining area under chandelier lighting, and plush living room along with a Main Floor King Suite. The second floor includes three additional king suites, and a bunk room with sleeping for 4 in twin bunks. The fenced-in outdoor living space expands through the French doors of the living room to showcase a private cocktail pool (can be heated for an additional fee for reservations October - April) and a screened-in outdoor lounge with summer kitchen, dining, cushioned seating set and outdoor TV. And don't forget about complimentary use of an LSV (golf cart) available with your reservation (some restrictions). The Dragonfly community pool is a short walk away, and shopping and dining options are close by at the WaterColor Crossings shopping center. Area Construction - Due to the outstanding beaches, beautiful emerald water, and amazing communities along 30A, our area is getting more and more popular each year. Along with this comes a higher demand for housing, restaurants, etc. and projects in the communities to meet these demands. There is a high possibility of nearby construction, home remodels, community changes and county projects on the roads and bridges along 30A year-round and throughout every single community. Please be aware that refunds will not be issued due to noise disturbance or unsightly views due to nearby projects.
